user.title: Smart meter
user.description: Connect the IR reading head to the meter and to this Home Assistant host. Stop the Smartmeter add-on first if it uses the same port.

data_description.key: 32 hex characters, sent to you by your grid operator.
data_description.interface_type: Only used for Burgenland and Wien. NÖ always uses the wired M-Bus port.

error.invalid_key: The key must be exactly 32 hex characters.
error.cannot_connect: The serial port cannot be opened.
error.no_data: No valid telegram received. Check the key, the meter type, the reading head position and that the customer interface is activated.

data_description.update_interval: Seconds between entity updates. The meter sends every 1-5 seconds; lower values write more to the database.

options.wien: Wiener Netze (Siemens IM150/IM350/IM351, Iskraemeco AM550, Landis+Gyr E450)
